preconditions.description: The input n is an integer between 1 and 100000 inclusive.
The stdin contains exactly one integer n.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.
The output is a permutation of numbers from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in p)
postconditions.description: Every element in the output is a valid volume number between 1 and n.
The number of divisors for the output permutation is less than or equal to that of the identity permutation (1, 2, ..., n), ensuring minimality.
